review.reason: Approve candidate 30. The artwork maps confidently left-to-right to the supplied geometry: Hole 1 is the long par 5 with the substantial right-side shoreline lake, two left fairway bunkers, and a mixed back/right greenside bunker cluster; Hole 2 is the island-green par 3 with one front-right bunker on the lower approach land; Hole 3 is the short no-water par 4 with a sweeping fairway and right/back greenside bunkers. No clear bunker-side or water-extent contradiction is strong enough to justify geometry edits. As a round, it has excellent strategic and format variety: a positional lake-lined par 5, a full-carry island par 3, and a short attackable double-dogleg par 4. Difficulty is demanding but still fair from the sim evidence, with reasonable safe options on all three holes and good separation of shot types.
